items.html: But the sun and the moon, and the rest of the candles of light, which are the five planets, as I explained, they are the seven Sefirot of the construction themselves, which are revealed in the Yesod and bestow in it. And moreover, the six extremities are in the secret of the Tifferet, which includes the six extremities; and the seven Sefirot are opposite the seven planets, and this is not in the six extremities, for these are in the Tifferet itself alone, in its inclusion of them; and that is in the construction itself. And that suffices.
